claim: The Supercoppa Italiana stopped being a two-club match: from the January 2024 edition onward it is a four-team Final Four (league champion, league runner-up, Coppa Italia winner, Coppa Italia runner-up), so the stem's premise "contested between which two clubs each year" and the keyed answer are no longer true.
q: The Supercoppa Italiana is contested between which two clubs each year?
o: The league champion and cup winner
The top two in the league
answer: The league champion and cup winner
